title: Service Contracts: Changing the Minimum Quantity Commitment During the Term
content:
The minimum quantity commitment of an AHL Service Contract can be raised, and in some tiers lowered, by amendment. This page sets how late such a change may be filed, how large it may be, and what becomes of the tier when the new figure no longer fits the tier's band.

## Clauses

- **Latest filing.** A change of commitment must be filed no fewer than the tier's stated number of calendar days before the expiry date. A filing that falls exactly that many days before expiry is in time.
- **Increase.** An increase may add at most the tier's percentage of the commitment in force when the change is made.
- **Reduction.** A reduction is possible only in a tier that permits it, and then by at most the tier's percentage of the commitment in force.
- **Tier after the change.** When the amended commitment lies outside the band of the contract's tier, the contract keeps that tier until the end of the term. It moves to the band matching the new commitment only at renewal.
- **Effect.** Once the amendment is filed, the contract carries the new commitment.

## Commitment change limits by tier

| Tier | Largest increase (percent of current commitment) | Reduction permitted | Largest reduction (percent of current commitment) | Filing deadline (calendar days before expiry) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AHL Starter Service Contract` | 50 | no | 0 | 60 |
| `AHL Standard Service Contract` | 50 | no | 0 | 60 |
| `AHL Regional Account Contract` | 50 | no | 0 | 60 |
| `AHL Key Account Contract` | 100 | yes | 10 | 90 |
| `AHL Global Account Contract` | 100 | yes | 15 | 90 |
| `AHL Strategic Partner Contract` | 200 | yes | 20 | 90 |

## Worked examples (hypothetical contracts)

- A Standard contract of 200 FEU may be raised to at most 300 FEU, an addition of 50 percent. It may not be reduced.
- A Global Account contract of 3000 FEU may be reduced to no less than 2550 FEU: 15 percent of 3000 is 450.
- A Key Account contract of 1800 FEU is raised by 100 percent to 3600 FEU, a figure above the Key Account band. It remains a Key Account contract for the rest of its term.
- A Key Account contract expiring on 31 December must have a commitment change filed by 2 October, 90 calendar days earlier. A filing on 2 October is in time; one on 3 October is too late.
- A Regional Account contract expiring on 31 December can take a commitment change filed as late as 1 November, 60 calendar days before expiry.
